DefaultChoiceDisplayText.SourceString: Could you smith me a magnetised iron bar?
DefaultChoiceDisplayText.LocalizedString: Could you smith me a magnetised iron bar?

DefaultChoiceDisplayText.SourceString: I've got all the information I need
DefaultChoiceDisplayText.LocalizedString: I've got all the information I need

DefaultChoiceDisplayText.SourceString: Ask about the Magnetised Iron Bar
DefaultChoiceDisplayText.LocalizedString: Ask about the Magnetised Iron Bar

Message.SourceString: Oi oi!
Message.LocalizedString: Oi oi!

Message.SourceString: Howdy, lankylegs.
Message.LocalizedString: Howdy, lankylegs.

Message.SourceString: Got a moment for ol' Manktongue?
Message.LocalizedString: Got a moment for ol' Manktongue?

Message.SourceString: You got no space,  grotface. Huh-huh, I rhymed.
Message.LocalizedString: You got no space,  grotface. Huh-huh, I rhymed.

Message.SourceString: Wait - is that a chicken stuck to a cliff face?
Message.LocalizedString: Wait - is that a chicken stuck to a cliff face?

Message.SourceString: The undead magnetised chicken tries to nibble your neck as you bundle it into your bag.
Message.LocalizedString: The undead magnetised chicken tries to nibble your neck as you bundle it into your bag.

Message.SourceString: You would grab the undead magnetised chicken, but you have no space in your inventory.
Message.LocalizedString: You would grab the undead magnetised chicken, but you have no space in your inventory.

Message.SourceString: What an odd-looking bundle of twigs.
Message.LocalizedString: What an odd-looking bundle of twigs.

Message.SourceString: The bundle of undead twigs moans as you stash them in your backpack.
Message.LocalizedString: The bundle of undead twigs moans as you stash them in your backpack.

Message.SourceString: You would pick up the bundle of undead twigs, but you have no space in your inventory.
Message.LocalizedString: You would pick up the bundle of undead twigs, but you have no space in your inventory.

Message.SourceString: Before ya go, do ya wanna ask ol' Manktongue anyfink?
Message.LocalizedString: Before ya go, do ya wanna ask ol' Manktongue anyfink?

Message.SourceString: Before ya go, do ya wanna ask ol' Manktongue anyfink?
Message.LocalizedString: Before ya go, do ya wanna ask ol' Manktongue anyfink?

Message.SourceString: Need help with da in-greedy-yums for the Arrow Grabber?
Message.LocalizedString: Need help with da in-greedy-yums for the Arrow Grabber?

Message.SourceString: So, full diss-closure: Manktongue got as far as findin' an undead chicken.
Message.LocalizedString: So, full diss-closure: Manktongue got as far as findin' an undead chicken.

Message.SourceString: Thing is, Manktongue got da order of opper-ations wrong and axey-dentally magnetised it.
Message.LocalizedString: Thing is, Manktongue got da order of opper-ations wrong and axey-dentally magnetised it.

Message.SourceString: Undead chicken is headin' due north. Probby got stuck to somethin' metal. If you head north, I reckon you'll find da chicken in no time.
Message.LocalizedString: Undead chicken is headin' due north. Probby got stuck to somethin' metal. If you head north, I reckon you'll find da chicken in no time.

Message.SourceString: Unless it's been eaten by a Garou, and den you're looking for a magnetised, undead Garou.
Message.LocalizedString: Unless it's been eaten by a Garou, and den you're looking for a magnetised, undead Garou.

Message.SourceString: Magnetisin' stuff ain't that 'ard.
Message.LocalizedString: Magnetisin' stuff ain't that 'ard.

Message.SourceString: Bring five law runes and an iron bar to Pulpknuckle up da stairs and he'll do it for ya.
Message.LocalizedString: Bring five law runes and an iron bar to Pulpknuckle up da stairs and he'll do it for ya.

Message.SourceString: Advert is vague about undead twigs, right? Manktongue plan to give dat feedback to Ava when he meets her.
Message.LocalizedString: Advert is vague about undead twigs, right? Manktongue plan to give dat feedback to Ava when he meets her.

Message.SourceString: Only place Ol' Manktongue as seen dem is in Bloodblight Swamp. Near a tree with glowy orange stuff on it.
Message.LocalizedString: Only place Ol' Manktongue as seen dem is in Bloodblight Swamp. Near a tree with glowy orange stuff on it.

Message.SourceString: It's an 'orrible place. You will need to find a tree wiv glowing orange warty bits all over it.
Message.LocalizedString: It's an 'orrible place. You will need to find a tree wiv glowing orange warty bits all over it.

Message.SourceString: Oo, get you.
Message.LocalizedString: Oo, get you.

Message.SourceString: Go get all da in-greedy-yums mentioned in da advert, 'an bring them back to me. I'll be takin' a load off.
Message.LocalizedString: Go get all da in-greedy-yums mentioned in da advert, 'an bring them back to me. I'll be takin' a load off.

Message.SourceString: What can ol' Manktongue do for you?
Message.LocalizedString: What can ol' Manktongue do for you?

Message.SourceString: It part of ol' Manktongue now.
Message.LocalizedString: It part of ol' Manktongue now.

Message.SourceString: It comes wiv da territory. I am a pie-in-ear, af'er all.
Message.LocalizedString: It comes wiv da territory. I am a pie-in-ear, af'er all.

Message.SourceString: Well, it's good to see ya again.
Message.LocalizedString: Well, it's good to see ya again.

Message.SourceString: Look me up on Link Tin.
Message.LocalizedString: Look me up on Link Tin.

Message.SourceString: Oi oi! Looks like ya got all da in-greedy-yums for the Arrow Grabba. Want me to work my magic?
Message.LocalizedString: Oi oi! Looks like ya got all da in-greedy-yums for the Arrow Grabba. Want me to work my magic?

Message.SourceString: Okay. A little glue here. A little elbow grease there. Ta-da! Made you one Arrow grabba!
Message.LocalizedString: Okay. A little glue here. A little elbow grease there. Ta-da! Made you one Arrow grabba!

Message.SourceString: Cool beans. Let ol' Manktongue know when you ready for da next step.
Message.LocalizedString: Cool beans. Let ol' Manktongue know when you ready for da next step.

Message.SourceString: I'm gonna come clean to ya: I may have con-figgered da Arrow Grabba a tad.
Message.LocalizedString: I'm gonna come clean to ya: I may have con-figgered da Arrow Grabba a tad.

Message.SourceString: Some of da arrows are gonna come to ol' Manktongue. Call it da Manktongue Tax. Dat's biz-ness for ya.
Message.LocalizedString: Some of da arrows are gonna come to ol' Manktongue. Call it da Manktongue Tax. Dat's biz-ness for ya.

Message.SourceString: But I fink you will be pleased, none-da-less.
Message.LocalizedString: But I fink you will be pleased, none-da-less.

Message.SourceString: Go forth! Fire dem arrows, grab dem arrows! And who knows? Maybe we can come to anuvver deal in the foo-ture?
Message.LocalizedString: Go forth! Fire dem arrows, grab dem arrows! And who knows? Maybe we can come to anuvver deal in the foo-ture?

Message.SourceString: Oi oi, you ain't got room for da Arrow Grabba!
Message.LocalizedString: Oi oi, you ain't got room for da Arrow Grabba!

Message.SourceString: Come back when you got a single space to carry it.
Message.LocalizedString: Come back when you got a single space to carry it.

Message.SourceString: Nice day fer a walk, innit?
Message.LocalizedString: Nice day fer a walk, innit?

Message.SourceString: Oi oi! Good to see me ol' bizness partner again!
Message.LocalizedString: Oi oi! Good to see me ol' bizness partner again!

Message.SourceString: Manktongue's got an opper-toonity for ya. It'll blow yer bronze boots off.
Message.LocalizedString: Manktongue's got an opper-toonity for ya. It'll blow yer bronze boots off.

Message.SourceString: I like hitting fings, I do.
Message.LocalizedString: I like hitting fings, I do.

Message.SourceString: Nice, nice. Here's the deal-io. Ol' Manktongue found a message in a bottle. It's an advert-eye-cement from da mainland.
Message.LocalizedString: Nice, nice. Here's the deal-io. Ol' Manktongue found a message in a bottle. It's an advert-eye-cement from da mainland.

Message.SourceString: Your loss, stinkum.
Message.LocalizedString: Your loss, stinkum.

Message.SourceString: Howdy, lankylegs.
Message.LocalizedString: Howdy, lankylegs.

Message.SourceString: Manktongue try to make da machine described in da advert-eye-cement, but fings not go to plan.
Message.LocalizedString: Manktongue try to make da machine described in da advert-eye-cement, but fings not go to plan.

Message.SourceString: But now YOU here. And YOU be Manktongue's bizness partner. YOU help Manktongue make da machine.
Message.LocalizedString: But now YOU here. And YOU be Manktongue's bizness partner. YOU help Manktongue make da machine.

Message.SourceString: Have a look at da advert-inna-bottle next to me. Talk to me after, an' we can work out terms.
Message.LocalizedString: Have a look at da advert-inna-bottle next to me. Talk to me after, an' we can work out terms.

Message.SourceString: To all inventors! Rather than patent or make money from my invention - AVA'S ACCUMULATOR - I have made the decision to make it freely available.
Message.LocalizedString: To all inventors! Rather than patent or make money from my invention - AVA'S ACCUMULATOR - I have made the decision to make it freely available.

Message.SourceString: This invention will offer a chance to recover any metal-based arrows that are lost when firing a ranged weapon.
Message.LocalizedString: This invention will offer a chance to recover any metal-based arrows that are lost when firing a ranged weapon.

Message.SourceString: Components:1 x Undead Chicken, 1 x Magnetised Iron Bar and 1 x Undead Twig Bundle.
Message.LocalizedString: Components:1 x Undead Chicken, 1 x Magnetised Iron Bar and 1 x Undead Twig Bundle.

Message.SourceString: Happy building, fellow inventors! Ava
Message.LocalizedString: Happy building, fellow inventors! Ava
